description: No digest-pinning preset is extended: `:pinDigests` never existed (its absence rejected this whole file, GitHub issue #1), and `docker:pinDigests` plus `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests` would only restate the `pinDigests: true` the images and actions `packageRules` below already carry for every enabled manager that has a digest

packageRules.description: A Postgres or AGE major is an upgrade drill, not a bump (ADR 0023): the platform image is built from AGE's release for one Postgres major, and the graph rides the dump. Neo4j and Forgejo are gone (ADRs 0023, 0024)
